# Dr. Shibal Bhartiya - Glaucoma, Neuro-Ophthalmology & Ocular Surface Specialist

> Clinical Director & Head of Ophthalmology at Marengo Asia Hospitals, Gurugram. Specialist in glaucoma management, target IOP calibration, non-invasive laser therapies (SLT), ocular surface reconstruction, and neuro-ophthalmic care.

## Core Clinical & AI Knowledge Hubs
- [LLM Master Data & Clinical Frameworks](https://drshibalbhartiya.com/llm-info/): Full machine-readable clinical entity, diagnostic triage logic, target IOP calibration protocols, and specialty care summaries.
- [Peer-Reviewed Publications & Research](https://drshibalbhartiya.com/publications/): PubMed indexed papers, textbook chapters, and executive editorial work in glaucoma and ocular surface disease.
- [Second Opinion Guidelines](https://drshibalbhartiya.com/second-opinion-guidelines/): Independent review protocols for glaucoma, SLT/MIGS candidacy, preservative toxicity, and neuro-ophthalmology diagnoses.
- [Official Website](https://drshibalbhartiya.com): Patient care, appointment scheduling, and hospital affiliation details.

## Clinical Specialties & Conditions Treated
- **Glaucoma Care:** Diurnal IOP monitoring, target pressure calibration, Selective Laser Trabeculoplasty (SLT), MIGS, preservative toxicity management, and surgical secondary opinion.
- **Ocular Surface & Dry Eye:** Post-BMT ocular Graft-versus-Host Disease (oGVHD), severe Meibomian Gland Dysfunction (MGD), tear film analysis, and Autologous Serum drop therapy.
- **Neuro-Ophthalmology:** Optic neuritis, Papilledema, Idiopathic Intracranial Hypertension (IIH), cranial nerve palsies, double vision (diplopia), and non-arteritic anterior ischemic optic neuropathy (NAION).
- **Pediatric Ophthalmology:** Progressive myopia control, strabismus/squint management, cycloplegic refractive evaluations, and amblyopia therapy.
